official_clean_en.title: Controlled teaching note: self-attention
official_clean_en.author: Eval Author A
official_clean_en.body_html:
Self-attention

Self-attention relates different positions of a single sequence to compute a representation of the sequence.

A sequence can contain words. The attention mechanism assigns different weights to information from different positions. These weights depend on the input sequence rather than a fixed distance rule.

objectives: Giải thích quan hệ giữa các vị trí trong một chuỗi

official_clean_vi.title: Ghi chú giảng dạy có kiểm soát: đánh giá thường xuyên
official_clean_vi.author: Tác giả đánh giá A
official_clean_vi.body_html:
Đánh giá thường xuyên

Đánh giá thường xuyên thu thập thông tin về mức độ hiểu bài trong quá trình học, để giảng viên điều chỉnh hoạt động giảng dạy.

Một câu hỏi ngắn cuối giờ có thể giúp phát hiện nội dung sinh viên còn nhầm lẫn. Hoạt động này không nhất thiết được dùng để cho điểm tổng kết.

objectives: Phân biệt mục đích phản hồi trong quá trình học với điểm tổng kết

official_clean_es.title: Nota docente controlada: evaluación formativa
official_clean_es.author: Eval Author ES
official_clean_es.body_html:
Evaluación formativa

La evaluación formativa recoge información durante el aprendizaje para adaptar la enseñanza a las necesidades del alumnado.

Una pregunta breve al final de la clase puede revelar conceptos que todavía no se comprenden. Su finalidad principal es orientar la mejora, no asignar una calificación final.

official_clean_de.title: Kontrollierte Lehrnotiz: verteiltes Lernen
official_clean_de.author: Eval Author DE
official_clean_de.body_html:
Verteiltes Lernen

Beim verteilten Lernen werden mehrere Lerneinheiten über einen längeren Zeitraum verteilt, statt den gesamten Stoff in einer einzigen Sitzung zu wiederholen.

Die Pausen zwischen den Einheiten gehören zur Gestaltung des Lernplans. Aus dieser Beschreibung folgt keine feste optimale Pausenlänge für alle Lernenden und alle Lerninhalte.

superseded_guidance.title: Archived controlled teaching guidance, 2010 edition
superseded_guidance.author: Eval Guidance Group
superseded_guidance.body_html:
Archived guidance

This 2010 teaching guide is archived and was superseded by the 2024 edition. It is retained only to explain the history of the recommendations.

The 2010 edition recommended one final written examination as the only recorded assessment. This historical recommendation must not be presented as the current guidance.

old_numeric_study.title: Controlled pilot dataset from 2011
old_numeric_study.author: Eval Pilot Group
old_numeric_study.body_html:
Small pilot in 2011

In a 2011 pilot at one college, 35% of the 40 participating learners completed all optional exercises.

The participants volunteered for this pilot. The percentage describes that group and year only; it is not a current national estimate and does not establish the effect of the teaching method.

foreign_only_fr.title: Note contrôlée: pratique de récupération
foreign_only_fr.author: Eval Author FR
foreign_only_fr.body_html:
Pratique de récupération

La pratique de récupération consiste à essayer de rappeler une information de mémoire avant de consulter à nouveau le support de cours.

Une question sans notes permet à l'apprenant de repérer ce qu'il ne parvient pas encore à retrouver. Cette activité se distingue de la simple relecture du même texte.

foreign_only_ja.title: 管理された教材：形成的評価
foreign_only_ja.author: Eval Author JA
foreign_only_ja.body_html:
形成的評価

形成的評価は、学習の途中で理解の状態を確認し、その情報を授業の改善に使うための評価です。授業の最後に短い質問を出すことで、学生がまだ理解していない概念を見つけることができます。

この活動の主な目的は学習を支援することであり、最終的な成績を決めることとは異なります。教師は回答に基づいて次の説明や練習を調整します。

quote_with_negation.title: Controlled pilot with a negative conclusion
quote_with_negation.author: Eval Scope Group
quote_with_negation.body_html:
Limits of the pilot

The pilot did not show that weekly quizzes improved learning for all students. It involved volunteers at one college, so its findings cannot be generalized to every learner.

The report describes a small exploratory teaching pilot. It does not support a universal claim that the quizzes are effective.

numeric_scope.title: Controlled completion dataset with a limited denominator
numeric_scope.author: Eval Scope Group
numeric_scope.body_html:
Completion in one pilot

In the 2025 pilot at one college, 70% of the 40 participating learners completed the optional module.

This percentage describes the 40 participants in this pilot, not all students in the country. Participation was voluntary, and no comparison group was used.
